action.action-desc: Mrs. Luna (for herself and Mr. Gill of Texas) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary

form.official-title: To codify Executive Order 14418 (relating to continuing to protect the meaning and value of American citizenship).

section.header: Continuing to protect the meaning and value of american citizenship
section.text: Executive Order 14418 (91 Fed. Reg. 51991; Continuing To Protect the Meaning and Value of American Citizenship) shall have the full force and effect of law.
